title: Globally filtered clone constraint
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. Given natural numbers $r,M$ and a bound saying every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$, each globally filtered clone occurrence determines a constraint over variables $V\times\mathrm{Fin}(M)$: it uses the predicate selected by the refined outcome, and its ordered scope sends each position to the original variable paired with that position's assigned clone index.
